result.topic_en: Riemann considers Abelian functions on a covering surface where a cross-cut is continued and repeated λ times; he computes the moduli of periodicity of the normal integrals at the cross-cuts and writes the resulting quadratic form in the exponent of the theta series Ω, reducing the summation indices modulo ρ.

methods.what: Definition of normal integrals on the λ-fold repeated surface and their periods at cross-cuts
Decomposition of integrals via sums over roots of unity (discrete Fourier transform)
Inversion formula expressing w in terms of u and v
Relation between period moduli c and transformed moduli b
Theta series Ω of the covering rewritten in transformed variables n with congruence condition
Theta function in the v-variables and its vanishing points

items.english: The theta function of (v − e) vanishes at (ρ−1)(λ−1) points.
